title: TSMC Reports Fourth Quarter EPS of NT$19.50
availability_basis: publication date; time conservatively capped at end of day
summary: TSMC reported fourth-quarter 2025 revenue of NT$1,046.09 billion, net income of NT$505.74 billion and diluted EPS of NT$19.50. Revenue increased 20.5% year over year, net income and EPS increased 35.0%, gross margin was 62.3% and advanced technologies represented 77% of wafer revenue.

title: TSMC Reports First Quarter EPS of NT$22.08
availability_basis: publication date; time conservatively capped at end of day
summary: TSMC reported first-quarter 2026 revenue of NT$1,134.10 billion, up 35.1% year over year, net income of NT$572.48 billion, up 58.3%, diluted EPS of NT$22.08, gross margin of 66.2% and operating margin of 58.1%.
